Requests.p: All reservations must be submitted in writing via email or other official communication channels. Reservation requests should include the guest's full name, arrival and departure dates, room type, and whether the reservation qualifies as an export of services. The reservation must also identify the person responsible for the booking.

individual.p1: Individual reservations apply to bookings of one to six guests.
individual.p2: Reservations should be reconfirmed at least ten (10) days before arrival. Payment must be completed seven (7) days prior to check-in.
individual.p3: Reservations made within fifteen (15) days of arrival must be reconfirmed at least seven (7) days before check-in and paid four (4) days prior to arrival.

group.p1: Group reservations apply to bookings of seven (7) guests or more.
group.p2: Reservations made two months or more in advance may be modified, reconfirmed or cancelled up to forty (40) days before the group's arrival.
group.p3: A deposit of fifty percent (50%) of the reservation value is required. The remaining balance must be paid at least five (5) days before arrival.

children.p1: Children under seven (7) years of age stay free of charge when sharing a room with their parents.
children.p2: Complimentary cribs are available for children from 0 to 4 years old, subject to availability.
children.p3: Children aged seven (7) years and above are considered adults for accommodation purposes.
children.p4: A maximum of one child is permitted per room.

cancellation.p1: Group reservations may be cancelled without penalty up to forty (40) days before arrival.
cancellation.p2: Individual reservations may be cancelled without penalty up to seven (7) days before arrival.
cancellation.p3: Cancellations received after these deadlines or failure to arrive without prior notice (No Show) will incur a charge equivalent to the first night's stay.

taxes.p1: Applicable taxes will be charged according to Peruvian legislation. Foreign visitors may qualify for tax exemption upon presentation of a valid passport and immigration documentation.

creditTerms.p1: Approved credit accounts have a payment period of fifteen (15) days from the invoice date.

complimentary.p1: For group reservations, every sixteenth guest is considered complimentary according to Hotel Midori's current group policy.

contact.p1: For additional information regarding these Terms & Conditions or reservation policies, please contact Hotel Midori directly.

header.p: Learn how Hotel Midori collects, uses and protects your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

introduction.p: Hotel Midori is committed to protecting the privacy of our guests and website visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and safeguard your personal information.

collection.p: We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number and reservation details when you contact us or request our services.

usage.p: Your information is used to manage reservations, respond to inquiries, improve our services and provide assistance before, during and after your stay.

thirdParty.p: Our website may include services such as Google Maps and WhatsApp. These platforms have their own privacy policies and may collect information according to their respective terms.

cookies.p: Our website may use cookies to improve browsing performance and enhance your experience. You may disable cookies through your browser settings.

contact.p: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal information, please contact Hotel Midori directly.
